note: The opportunity deck for the money boat's return (Six-faces-council money-block.md, his note on mb-return-build-look-1). A boat that comes home opens its crate on one card: a fifteen-minute way to move the money needle that the port sent back. Cards are keyed by port id; a port this deck does not know draws from 'any'. 'from_boat' cards are built from the boat's own move and port, so the first thing back is about what the player sent. {port}, {action} and {ask} are filled from the boat. bonus is paid on top of the move's usual three vibeulons when the card is played off the hatch. element is the port's Wuxing colour on the card (bars-engine UI_COVENANT.md), with its reason.

courses.why: a course is knowledge that flows on: water

games.why: games are play and heat: fire

books.why: a book is refined craft: metal

patreon.why: patrons are ground that holds steady: earth

jobs.why: a job is structure and a contract: metal

any.why: a port the deck does not know yet stands on earth

from_boat.title: A reply in the hold
from_boat.line: {port} wrote back about what you sent.
from_boat.action: Send a two-line follow-up about {ask}: thank them, and name one next step with a date.

from_boat.title: A second door
from_boat.line: The person at {port} mentioned someone else who should hear this.
from_boat.action: Ask who else at {port} should see {ask}, in one sentence, and offer to send it.

from_boat.title: A date to hear back
from_boat.line: {port} has your move; a date keeps it from drifting off.
from_boat.action: Write down when you expect to hear back about {ask}, and set one reminder to ask on that day.

coaching.title: A name for your sessions
coaching.line: Someone you coached once has a friend in the same knot.
coaching.action: Ask one past client, by message, who they know that would want a session.

coaching.title: A free half hour
coaching.line: A slot opened in the week ahead.
coaching.action: Offer one person a free thirty-minute call this week with a link to book it.

coaching.title: A price said aloud
coaching.line: The port wants to hear what a session costs.
coaching.action: Write your session price in one sentence and post it where clients look.

courses.title: A list that wants in
courses.line: Three people asked when the course opens.
courses.action: Write a two-line note to your waitlist with the date and the price.

courses.title: One lesson, given away
courses.line: A lesson out in the world brings buyers back.
courses.action: Share one lesson from the course in public with a link to the full course.

courses.title: A teacher who would host it
courses.line: Another teacher's students would like this course.
courses.action: Ask one teacher if they would share your course with their students for a cut.

games.title: A paid table
games.line: A group wants to play your game.
games.action: Offer one group a paid playtest night with a price and a date.

games.title: A shelf in a shop
games.line: A local shop has an empty shelf.
games.action: Email one game shop about stocking your game, with a photo and the price.

games.title: A page that sells
games.line: The game's page has visitors but no buy button.
games.action: Add a buy or pledge link to the game's page and share it once.

books.title: A reader with a voice
books.line: A reader loved the book and has not said so in public.
books.action: Ask one reader to leave a review where the book is sold.

books.title: A box of books
books.line: A group could use copies for everyone.
books.action: Offer one group, class or circle a bulk price on the book.

books.title: A night to read aloud
books.action: Ask one venue for a reading date with books for sale at the door.

patreon.title: A patron to thank
patreon.line: A patron has stayed a long time without a word back.
patreon.action: Thank one patron by name and ask what they would like more of.

patreon.title: A tier with a door
patreon.line: A higher tier would fit someone who already gives.
patreon.action: Write one new tier in three lines, with its price, and post it.

patreon.title: An open invitation
patreon.line: Friends of the work have not been asked.
patreon.action: Invite three people who like the work to join, with the link.

jobs.title: A word from someone
jobs.line: Someone who knows your work would vouch for you.
jobs.action: Ask one past colleague to be a reference, in two lines.

jobs.title: A coffee on the calendar
jobs.line: Someone inside the place you applied would talk.
jobs.action: Ask one person who works there for a twenty-minute call.

jobs.title: The next posting
jobs.line: A posting like this one is open somewhere else.
jobs.action: Find one more posting like this one and save it with its closing date.

any.title: One more ask
any.line: The port is open to one more offer.
any.action: Send one person a plain offer with a price.

any.title: A thank-you that opens
any.line: Someone helped and has not heard back.
any.action: Thank one person who helped and ask what they need next.
